name: navigate_relative
about: A site path the crawl knows.

about: Trailing slash ignored when matching, dropped from the emitted url.

name: navigate_absolute_same_origin

name: navigate_query_dropped
about: The query string never reaches the client.

about: Keys outside the contract are not forwarded.

name: navigate_unknown_page
